notes.title: New New Year update | 3.6
notes.notes:
🎉 Granny Remake Update 3.6 is Live! 🎉

🎆 Happy New Year, everyone! 🎆  
The team at Granny Remake wishes you a fantastic new year filled with creepy escapes, fun moments, and plenty of challenges. To kick things off, we’ve prepared a fresh update for you!  

What’s New in 3.6?  

    🚀 Performance Boost — the game now runs smoother and faster than ever.  
    🛸 New Escape: UFO — find a way to escape by hitching a ride to space!  
    🎮 Steam Deck Support — fully optimized for handheld gaming.  
    ❄️ Winter is Back — switch between winter and autumn modes (winter’s here, just like you asked!).  
    🖼️ Visual Improvements — better lighting, textures, and overall game atmosphere.  
    🔦 Darkness Mode — turn off all the lights and see how brave you really are.  
    🎁 Loads of New Items — discover and use new stuff to help you escape.  


We’ve worked hard to make the game look and feel even better. Everything’s sharper, creepier, and more fun to explore!  

[hr][/hr]

🎮 What’s Next?  
In update 3.7, we’re bringing AMD FSR support and another brand-new escape route. 🤫 No spoilers yet, but trust us, it’s going to be epic!  

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for being an amazing community. Enjoy the update, and let us know what you think! 🎉

notes.title: New autumn update | 3.5
notes.notes:
🎉 Granny Remake Update! 🎉

Dear players, we are excited to present the latest update for Granny Remake. Here's the list of changes:


 Added a new car with a redesigned look.
 New floor — attic. You can now explore a new level with secrets and challenges.
 Introduced a new puzzle — shooting gallery in the attic.
 Added a metal detector puzzle to make it easier to find items.
 New escape option through the police. Use the flare gun to call for help.
 New item — flare gun.
 Added a new puzzle — cuckoo clock.
 A phone has been added to the game, allowing you to call the police.
 Improved environment: added spiders, cobwebs, and other atmospheric elements.
 Introduced color filters to customize the visual style of the game.
 Some doors now have a bell attached.
 Updated Granny's behavior: the flashlight now makes you more visible.
 Added the ability to peek around corners using the Q button.
 Introduced a scream volume slider to adjust the intensity of scare sounds.
 New death scene by electrocution.
 Added new paintings.
 Improved lighting in the game.
 Fixed known bugs and glitches.
 Added new music tracks to enhance the tension.
 Gameplay improvements have been made to increase the overall scare factor.


The update aims to improve the gameplay experience and add new features.

notes.title: New spring update | 3.4
notes.notes:
🎉 Major Update for "Granny Remake"! 🎉

Dear players, we are thrilled to announce a new update for Granny Remake! Here are the main changes we've implemented:

[olist]
New Electric Puzzle: You will need to figure out how to switch or disconnect electricity to progress in the game.
More Interactive Objects: We've added new items that influence gameplay.
Text Hints for Players: These will help you navigate better and make the right decisions.
Change of Location: The game now takes place in summer, adding new colors and atmosphere.
Improved Granny Behavior: Granny now reacts if you open something but won't hear you if you are far away.
New Menu Scene: The main menu has a revamped scene.
New Stealth Movement: Press ALT to move quietly — fast, silent, and without noise.
Medkit for Player: Use the medkit to restore strength and continue the game.
Changed Soda Effect: Drinking soda now temporarily increases your speed.
Enhanced Granny AI: Granny has become smarter and more dangerous.
Bug Fixes: We've resolved known issues to improve your interaction with the game.
[/olist]

Thank you for your support and feedback, which help us make Granny Remake better with each update! Try the new features and improvements, and share your experiences. Good luck trying to survive and escape from Granny!

notes.title: New winter update | 3.3
notes.notes:
🎉 Winter Update for "Granny Remake"! 🎉

We're excited to present our new winter update, significantly enriching the gaming experience:

[olist]
Optimization and Bug Fixes: We've worked hard to make the game run smoother, eliminating previous errors and making gameplay more stable and comfortable for players.
New Closet Capture Animation: Introducing a thrilling new mechanic - now Granny can catch you right in the closet. This not only adds novelty but also increases tension at key moments.
New Item – Tomato: Discover new tactics with the tomato, which can be used to temporarily distract Granny, giving you precious seconds to plan your next move.
Enhanced Visual Effects: We've significantly bolstered the visual aspect of the game, including more realistic effects that make immersion even more complete.
New Puzzle: Diversify your gaming experience with a new puzzle, adding an additional layer of intrigue and challenges to solve.
New Item Spawn Locations: We've expanded the number of places where items can appear, making exploration of the game world more exciting and unpredictable.
Festive Decorations: Festive decorations add an atmosphere of celebration and novelty, enlivening the game world in this magical season.
[/olist]
